decisions.reason: Separating LED and sensor power control does not necessarily change the requirement to monitor the aggregate 3.3V and 5V rail currents.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that LED power is controlled separately from sensor power.
Separate downstream LED and sensor controls do not change the established AXP2101 battery and USB power path.
The source does not confirm removal of the data-level shifter; its tentative wording is already represented by the candidate's same-message VALUE ambiguity.
The source concerns separate control of 5V LED and sensor loads and does not alter the standalone USB 3.3V supply.
The source does not specify any connector, pinout, or interboard signal change; separate controls can be implemented without necessarily changing this interface.
Separate LED and sensor power control does not entail a change to the sensor-board connector inventory or module interfaces.
The battery connector's series, mounting, and pinout are unrelated to separate LED and sensor power controls.
The source does not change the ESP32 BOOT or reset circuitry.
Separating sensor and LED power control does not change the SPS30 SEL pin's required connection to GND.
The separate-control decision does not change the indicator board's role or eight-LED count, and the source does not resolve its LED-model ambiguity.
The power-control topology change does not alter the specified ESP32-S3 module.
